Quest name: Buddhism in Nepal
Quest location: Alexandria Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Theology, MAL(Malay/Tagalog)
Pre-requisite discovery: Puskarini Pond discovery (from "The Land Where Buddha Was Born" quest) + Kathmandu Valley discovery (from "Unfinished Map") + Baalbek discovery (from "Results of Religious Syncretism" quest)(hidden)
Pre-requisite action: Priest's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
